text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find out what risks your project or business may face. These could be financial, technical, or related to people. Once you know the risks, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might buy insurance or train your team better. It is also wise to have contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something goes wrong. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay prepared and avoid serious trouble.
